requirements.requirement: Prove the full forward-error theorem for every model, coefficient list, and real evaluation point.
requirements.evidence: Research.Horner.forward_error_bound explicitly quantifies over every model, every finite real coefficient list (including empty), and every real x, and asserts the full forward-error inequality.

requirements.requirement: Use the exact Horner recursion with zero for the empty list and coefficients in increasing degree order.
requirements.evidence: P is defined by P([],x)=0 and P(a::t,x)=a+x*P(t,x). The first list entry is explicitly the constant coefficient; arithmetic is exact.

requirements.requirement: Evaluate each cons step using a rounded multiplication of x and the rounded tail, then a rounded addition of the coefficient.
requirements.evidence: Q is defined by Q(model,[],x)=0 and Q(model,a::t,x)=r(a+r(x*Q(model,t,x))), where r=model.round. This performs the specified rounded multiplication and addition at every entry.

requirements.requirement: Define the stated error envelope using exact values and u, with the requested recurrence and base case.
requirements.evidence: E is defined by E([],x,u)=0 and E(a::t,x,u)=u*|a+x*v|+(1+u)*(u*|x*v|+(1+u)*|x|*e), with v=P(t,x) and e=E(t,x,u). This is the prescribed recurrence and uses no Q or rounding.

requirements.requirement: Bound the absolute difference of the supplied rounded and exact evaluators by the supplied envelope.
requirements.evidence: The target directly asserts |Q(model,coefficients,x)-P(coefficients,x)|<=E(coefficients,x,model.u), using the constructed functions at the same inputs and the precise model parameter.

requirements.requirement: Use the supplied relative-error model without additional smallness, sign, nonzero, or exact-arithmetic premises.
requirements.evidence: The model requires u>=0 and for each real z some delta with |delta|<=u and r(z)=z*(1+delta). Delta may depend on z. The target explicitly has no further hypotheses: no smallness, sign, nonzero, input representability, or exact-rounding restriction.
